calculation.description: Trailing ten-session return divided by trailing twenty-session realized volatility scaled to a ten-session horizon; signal is lagged one completed session to prevent look-ahead. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted momentum.

signal_artifact.observation_rule: daily OHLCV through prior completed session

validation.regime_notes: Passed the benchmark gates on the cadence-aligned ten-session forward return. Positive in 2020-21 and 2024-26, weaker in 2022-23; recent 63-session sign was negative, so use in a diversified ensemble and monitor drift. Small cross-section implies conservative interpretation.
